metadata.title: EasyVista ITSM Integration for Microsoft Sentinel
metadata.description: Complete bidirectional integration between Microsoft Sentinel and EasyVista ITSM. Deploys 6 playbooks, 5 analytic rules, 5 hunting queries, a CISO dashboard workbook, and Content Hub solution metadata.
metadata.prerequisites: 1) Microsoft Sentinel workspace; 2) EasyVista ITSM API credentials (Bearer token); 3) Optional: Azure AD App Registration for MDE response actions

metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name where Microsoft Sentinel is deployed
Azure region for all deployed resources
EasyVista server hostname (e.g. your-company.easyvista.com). Can be configured later in each Logic App.
EasyVista account identifier used in API paths. Can be configured later in each Logic App.
EasyVista REST API Bearer token for authentication. Can be configured later in each Logic App.
Set to true to deploy all 6 Logic App playbooks for bidirectional integration
Set to true to deploy the CISO Dashboard workbook
Azure AD Tenant ID (required for TriggerResponseActions playbook - MDE API calls)
Azure AD App Registration Client ID for MDE API access (optional - for TriggerResponseActions)
Azure AD App Registration Client Secret for MDE API (optional - for TriggerResponseActions)

properties.displayName: EasyVista - High Severity Ticket SLA Breach
properties.description: Detects when a high-severity EasyVista security ticket has breached its SLA deadline while still open. This indicates the SOC or IT team has not resolved a critical security issue within the agreed timeframe.
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime,RFC_NUMBER:string,TITLE:string,SEVERITY_ID:int,STATUS_EN:string,REQUESTOR_NAME:string,REQUESTOR_EMAIL:string,RECIPIENT_NAME:string,DEPARTMENT_PATH:string,LOCATION_PATH:string,ASSET_TAG:string,MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT:datetime,REQUEST_TYPE:string)[] | where 1==0), EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| where SEVERITY_ID <= 2
| where STATUS_EN !in ("Closed", "Resolved")
| where isnotempty(MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT)
| where MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT < now()
| extend OverdueHours = datetime_diff('hour', now(), MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT)
| project TimeGenerated, RFC_NUMBER, ['TITLE'], SEVERITY_ID, STATUS_EN, REQUESTOR_NAME, REQUESTOR_EMAIL, RECIPIENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PATH, LOCATION_PATH, ASSET_TAG, MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT, OverdueHours

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: EasyVista ticket {{RFC_NUMBER}} (severity {{SEVERITY_ID}}) has breached SLA by {{OverdueHours}} hours.

properties.displayName: EasyVista - Ticket Status Sync Drift Detected
properties.description: Detects when a Sentinel incident status and its linked EasyVista ticket status are out of sync for more than 30 minutes. Ensures SOC and IT teams stay aligned.
properties.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Labels has "EV:"
| extend EVTicket = extract(@"EV:([^,\]]+)", 1, tostring(Labels))
| where isnotempty(EVTicket)
| join kind=inner (
    union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime,RFC_NUMBER:string,STATUS_EN:string,LAST_UPDATE:datetime,REQUEST_TYPE:string)[] | where 1==0), EasyVista_Tickets_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RFC_NUMBER
    | project RFC_NUMBER, EV_Status = STATUS_EN, EV_LastUpdate = LAST_UPDATE
) on $left.EVTicket == $right.RFC_NUMBER
| extend ExpectedEVStatus = case(Status == "New", "Open", Status == "Active", "Investigating", Status == "Closed", "Resolved", "Unknown")
| where EV_Status != ExpectedEVStatus
| where EV_Status != "Contained" or Status != "Active"
| where datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastModifiedTime) > 30
| project TimeGenerated, IncidentNumber, IncidentTitle = Title, SentinelStatus = Status, EVTicket, EV_Status, ExpectedEVStatus, DriftMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', now(), LastModifiedTime)

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Status sync drift detected. Sentinel #{{IncidentNumber}} and EasyVista {{EVTicket}} are out of sync for {{DriftMinutes}} minutes.

properties.displayName: EasyVista - Unusual Volume of Security Tickets
properties.description: Detects when the number of security-related EasyVista tickets created in the last hour exceeds the historical baseline by 3 standard deviations. May indicate a mass incident or phishing campaign.
properties.query:
let baseline = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime,REQUEST_TYPE:string)[] | where 1==0), EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(14d) .. ago(1h))
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| summarize HourlyCount = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| summarize AvgCount = avg(HourlyCount), StdDev = stdev(HourlyCount);
let current = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime,REQUEST_TYPE:string)[] | where 1==0), EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| summarize CurrentCount = count();
baseline
| join kind=cross current
| where CurrentCount > AvgCount + (3 * StdDev)
| extend Threshold = round(AvgCount + (3 * StdDev), 0)
| project TimeGenerated = now(), CurrentCount, BaselineAvg = round(AvgCount, 1), BaselineStdDev = round(StdDev, 1), Threshold, Deviation = round((CurrentCount - AvgCount) / StdDev, 1)

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: Unusual EasyVista Ticket Volume: {{CurrentCount}} tickets in 1h (baseline: {{BaselineAvg}})
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{CurrentCount}} security tickets created in the last hour, exceeding the baseline of {{BaselineAvg}} (threshold: {{Threshold}}).

properties.displayName: EasyVista - Repeated Security Incidents on Same Asset
properties.description: Detects assets that have been involved in 3+ security incidents within 7 days. Indicates persistent compromise, incomplete remediation, or a high-value target under sustained attack. Enriched with CMDB data.
properties.query:
union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime,RFC_NUMBER:string,ASSET_TAG:string,SEVERITY_ID:int,SUBMIT_DATE_UT:datetime,REQUEST_TYPE:string)[] | where 1==0), EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| where isnotempty(ASSET_TAG)
| summarize IncidentCount = count(), Tickets = make_set(RFC_NUMBER, 10), Severities = make_set(SEVERITY_ID, 10), FirstSeen = min(SUBMIT_DATE_UT), LastSeen = max(SUBMIT_DATE_UT) by ASSET_TAG
| where IncidentCount >= 3
| join kind=leftouter (
    union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime,ASSET_TAG:string,ASSET_LABEL:string,SERIAL_NUMBER:string,EMPLOYEE_NAME:string,EMPLOYEE_EMAIL:string,DEPARTMENT_PATH:string,LOCATION_PATH:string)[] | where 1==0), EasyVista_Assets_CL
    | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by ASSET_TAG
    | project ASSET_TAG, ASSET_LABEL, SERIAL_NUMBER, EMPLOYEE_NAME, EMPLOYEE_EMAIL, DEPARTMENT_PATH, LOCATION_PATH
) on ASSET_TAG
| project TimeGenerated = now(), ASSET_TAG, ASSET_LABEL, SERIAL_NUMBER, IncidentCount, Tickets, Severities, FirstSeen, LastSeen, AssignedUser = EMPLOYEE_NAME, AssignedEmail = EMPLOYEE_EMAIL, Department = DEPARTMENT_PATH, Location = LOCATION_PATH

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Asset {{ASSET_TAG}} has had {{IncidentCount}} security incidents in 7 days. Assigned to: {{AssignedUser}}.

properties.displayName: EasyVista - Sentinel Incident Without ITSM Ticket
properties.description: Detects Sentinel incidents older than 1 hour that have no linked EasyVista ticket (no EV: tag). Ensures all security incidents are tracked in the ITSM workflow.
properties.query:
SecurityIncident
| where TimeGenerated > ago(4h)
| where CreatedTime < ago(1h)
| where Status != "Closed"
| where not(Labels has "EV:")
| where Severity in ("High", "Medium")
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    IncidentNumber,
    IncidentTitle = Title,
    Severity,
    Status,
    CreatedTime,
    AlertCount = AdditionalData.alertsCount,
    Owner = tostring(Owner.assignedTo)

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Sentinel incident #{{IncidentNumber}} ({{Severity}}) has been open for over 1 hour without an EasyVista ticket. Owner: {{Owner}}

properties.displayName: EasyVista - Assets with Expired Warranty Linked to Incidents
properties.query:
EasyVista_Assets_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where isnotempty(END_OF_WARANTY) and END_OF_WARANTY < now()
| join kind=inner (
    EasyVista_Tickets_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
    | summarize IncidentCount = count(), LastIncident = max(SUBMIT_DATE_UT), Tickets = make_set(RFC_NUMBER, 5) by ASSET_TAG
) on ASSET_TAG
| project ASSET_TAG, ASSET_LABEL, SERIAL_NUMBER, END_OF_WARANTY, EMPLOYEE_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PATH, LOCATION_PATH, IncidentCount, LastIncident, Tickets
| sort by IncidentCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Hunts for assets that have expired warranties and have been involved in security incidents. These assets may lack vendor support for patching.

properties.query:
EasyVista_Employees_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where isnotempty(END_OF_CONTRACT) and END_OF_CONTRACT < now()
| join kind=inner (
    EasyVista_Tickets_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | summarize TicketCount = count(), LastTicket = max(SUBMIT_DATE_UT), Tickets = make_set(RFC_NUMBER, 5) by REQUESTOR_EMAIL
) on $left.E_MAIL == $right.REQUESTOR_EMAIL
| project EMPLOYEE_ID, LAST_NAME, E_MAIL, END_OF_CONTRACT, DEPARTMENT_PATH, LOCATION_PATH, TicketCount, LastTicket, Tickets
| sort by TicketCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Hunts for employees whose contracts have ended but who still appear as requestors on recent tickets. May indicate compromised credentials.

properties.displayName: EasyVista - Orphaned Tickets Missing Sentinel Linkage
properties.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| where ORIGIN == "API"
| where isempty(EXTERNAL_REFERENCE) or not(EXTERNAL_REFERENCE has "/subscriptions/")
| project TimeGenerated, RFC_NUMBER, ['TITLE'], STATUS_EN, SEVERITY_ID, REQUESTOR_NAME, ORIGIN, EXTERNAL_REFERENCE
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Hunts for EasyVista security tickets created via API that lack a valid EXTERNAL_REFERENCE. May indicate playbook failures.

properties.displayName: EasyVista - High Churn Tickets (Rapid Status Changes)
properties.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| summarize
    UpdateCount = count(),
    StatusChanges = dcount(STATUS_EN),
    Statuses = make_set(STATUS_EN),
    TimeSpanMinutes = datetime_diff('minute', max(LAST_UPDATE), min(SUBMIT_DATE_UT))
    by RFC_NUMBER, ['TITLE']
| where UpdateCount > 5 and TimeSpanMinutes < 60
| extend ChurnRate = round(toreal(UpdateCount) / iif(TimeSpanMinutes > 0, toreal(TimeSpanMinutes), 1.0), 2)
| sort by ChurnRate desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Hunts for tickets with suspiciously rapid status changes, which may indicate automated loops, sync issues, or ticket manipulation.

properties.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where REQUEST_TYPE has_any ("Incident", "I")
| where SEVERITY_ID <= 2
| summarize
    TicketCount = count(),
    Departments = make_set(DEPARTMENT_PATH, 20),
    DeptCount = dcount(DEPARTMENT_PATH),
    Locations = make_set(LOCATION_PATH, 20),
    Assets = make_set(ASSET_TAG, 20),
    Users = make_set(REQUESTOR_NAME, 20),
    Tickets = make_set(RFC_NUMBER, 20)
    by bin(TimeGenerated, 2h)
| where DeptCount >= 3
| project TimeGenerated, TicketCount, DeptCount, Departments, Locations, Assets, Users, Tickets
| sort by DeptCount desc

tags.name: description
tags.value: Hunts for security incidents affecting multiple departments simultaneously. May indicate lateral movement or organization-wide campaigns.

metadata.title: EasyVista - Create Incident Ticket (Full Attack Story)
metadata.description: Creates a high-fidelity EasyVista ticket ONLY for high-confidence Sentinel incidents (High/Medium severity with 2+ correlated alerts). Includes: full attack story with all alert details, chronological event timeline, automated root cause analysis (first-alert attribution + kill chain narrative), endpoint telemetry (hostname, IP, OS), user context, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and IOCs (IPs, file hashes, domains, URLs). Tags the EV RFC number back on the Sentinel incident for bidirectional tracking.
EasyVista server hostname (e.g., mycompany.easyvista.com)
EasyVista account ID (e.g., 50004)
EasyVista REST API Bearer token

Build_Root_Cause_Analysis.inputs:
@concat('============================================
ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS
============================================

','>>> PROBABLE INITIAL VECTOR (First Alert):
','    Alert: ', outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically')[0]?['AlertName'],'
','    Time: ', outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically')[0]?['Time'],'
','    Provider: ', outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically')[0]?['Provider'],'
','    Confidence: ', outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically')[0]?['ConfidenceLevel'],'
','    Description: ', outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically')[0]?['Description'],'
','    MITRE Tactic: ', outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically')[0]?['Tactics'],'
','    Technique: ', outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically')[0]?['Techniques'],'

','>>> KILL CHAIN PROGRESSION:
','    Total Correlated Alerts: ', string(length(outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically'))),'
','    Tactics Observed: ', join(coalesce(body('Parse_Incident')?['object']?['properties']?['additionalData']?['tactics'], createArray('None')),', '),'
','    Time Span: ', outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically')[0]?['Time'], ' → ', last(outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically'))?['Time'],'

','>>> ATTACK NARRATIVE:
','    The incident began with "', outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically')[0]?['AlertName'], '" detected by ', outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically')[0]?['Provider'], '.','
    This initial activity mapped to MITRE ', outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically')[0]?['Tactics'], ' (', outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically')[0]?['Techniques'], ').','
    ', string(length(outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically'))), ' total alert(s) were correlated into this incident across the observed kill chain.','
    The attack progressed through: ', join(coalesce(body('Parse_Incident')?['object']?['properties']?['additionalData']?['tactics'], createArray('Unknown')),  ' → '), '.','

','>>> RECOMMENDED IMMEDIATE ACTIONS:
','    1. Validate the initial vector alert with the affected user/asset owner
','    2. Check for lateral movement from the initial compromise point
','    3. Verify that containment actions have been applied
','    4. Preserve forensic evidence (memory dump, disk image if needed)
','    5. Assess blast radius across listed entities')

EasyVista Ticket Created (Full Attack Story)
RFC Number: @{body('Parse_EV_Response')?['RFC_NUMBER']}
Request ID: @{body('Parse_EV_Response')?['REQUEST_ID']}
Alerts Included: @{length(outputs('Sort_Alerts_Chronologically'))}

This incident will be tracked in Sentinel only. Manually run the playbook if ITSM tracking is needed.

metadata.title: EasyVista - Update Ticket Status (Bidirectional)
metadata.description: Syncs Sentinel incident status changes to EasyVista tickets. Maps: New→Open, Active→Investigating, Active+Containment→Contained, Closed→Resolved. Also adds an action entry in EasyVista with the status transition details.

body.DESCRIPTION:
@{concat('Sentinel incident status changed to: ',triggerBody()?['object']?['properties']?['status'],'
EasyVista status updated to: ',variables('evStatus'),'
Updated by: Microsoft Sentinel SOAR automation
Timestamp: ',utcNow())}

metadata.title: EasyVista - Trigger Response Actions
metadata.description: Polls EasyVista for tickets tagged with security response action requests (isolate host, kill process, quarantine file). Executes the requested action via Microsoft Defender for Endpoint API, then updates the EasyVista ticket with the action result. Enables IT teams to trigger security responses directly from ITSM workflows.
prerequisites: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint API permissions (Machine.Isolate, Machine.StopAndQuarantine)

metadata.description: Azure AD Tenant ID for MDE API authentication
App registration Client ID with MDE permissions
App registration Client Secret

body.DESCRIPTION:
@{concat('Security Response Action Executed
Action: ', outputs('Parse_Action_Type'), '
Target: ', outputs('Extract_Machine_Name'), '
Result: ', if(equals(outputs('Switch_Action_Type')?['statusCode'], 200), 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED'), '
Executed at: ', utcNow(), '
Executed by: Sentinel SOAR Automation')}

metadata.title: EasyVista - Sync Status to Sentinel (EV→Sentinel)
metadata.description: Polls EasyVista for recently updated tickets that have a Sentinel incident reference (EXTERNAL_REFERENCE). Syncs the EasyVista ticket status back to the corresponding Sentinel incident. Maps: Open→New, Investigating→Active, Contained→Active, Resolved→Closed. Ensures SOC and IT teams stay aligned in real time.

body.message:
EasyVista → Sentinel Sync

EV Status: @{items('For_Each_Linked_Ticket')?['STATUS']?['STATUS_EN']}
Sentinel Status set to: @{outputs('Map_EV_Status_to_Sentinel')}
Synced at: @{utcNow()}

properties.descriptionHtml: Complete bidirectional integration between Microsoft Sentinel and EasyVista ITSM. Includes 6 automation playbooks, 5 analytic rules, 5 hunting queries, and a CISO dashboard workbook.
